shared_elements: curved arcs and bands framing or enclosing circles
purely abstract curvilinear design with no figures
raised relief outlines with plain interiors
motifs covering the whole rounded stone surface without a frame or register
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive repertoire: circles and concentric ring-discs set inside larger oval or lozenge enclosures, linked and framed by sweeping curved arcs, all executed in raised rounded relief lines with plain interiors and no figurative content, spread over a domed stone face without registers or borders. The only real differences in content are of density and emphasis (A's motifs are more crowded and more spiral/serpentine, B's more open with a few large isolated ringed discs), which is variation within what looks like a single curvilinear-abstract convention.
